persona: Casual video creator new to music production
goal: A 30-second ambient soundtrack with audio plus MIDI/VST, using only the mouse
method: Independent simulated beginner session; no app source inspection or peer reports; screenshot discovery and logged mouse clicks/drags/scroll only. Post-task read-only artifact inspection verified evidence.

result.audio: Stock Circuit rhythm sample, repeated across four clips, final clip trimmed to 8 beats; gain 0.17
result.midi: Mouse-drawn sustained C4/D#4/G4 and D4/F4/A4 chords; four clips, final clip trimmed to 8 beats (21 notes fall inside clip bounds; 24 stored notes)
result.vst: Rill Lab Sine native VST3 selected via Device library and assigned to MIDI track; test fixture, not third-party validation
result.audio_audition: Not heard: laboratory uses null audio output. Both track meters animated during playback; final stereo float WAV contains nonzero samples. Musical quality cannot be judged.
result.save_export: Project, 30.000-second 48kHz stereo float WAV and MIDI export saved with default filenames using native mouse dialogs.

ratings_scale: 1-5, higher means more of the named quality. High confusion is worse. Simulated subjective ratings, not human research.

rating_reasons.easy_to_use: Empty-lane MIDI hint, labelled Pencil, context Duplicate and Fit enabled a full piece quickly. Exact timing and numeric edits needed exploration.
rating_reasons.how_cool_it_looks: Consistent charcoal/teal design, clean waveforms and focused views feel polished. Extensive empty canvas and very small ruler seconds reduce information density.
rating_reasons.how_fast_it_is: Controls responded promptly and the first MIDI/audio arrangement appeared in roughly two minutes. Export showed progress and completed; precise final trimming consumed additional time. Software rendering/null audio limit performance conclusions.
rating_reasons.how_confusing_it_is: Pencil selection moved toolbar controls, Range uses beats while ruler shows bars and seconds, and short trim adjustments seemed ineffective without inline feedback.
rating_reasons.feature_completeness: This task had working audio arrangement, native VST MIDI, piano roll, mixer, project save, WAV and MIDI export. Mouse-only exact numeric entry and clear duration feedback are weak; broader plugin/effect coverage untested.

findings.finding: Toolbar controls jump when changing edit tools
findings.observed: After selecting Pencil, Length moved from the left second row to far right first row. Clicking its previous position opened Grid scale instead.
findings.recommendation: Reserve a stable row or fixed slot for Length and Grid scale across tool changes.

findings.finding: Exact mouse-only duration is hard to inspect and adjust
findings.observed: Visual trim near 30s produced 30.134s. Tiny edge drags did not visibly change it. Duration properties entered text mode, and mouse wheel did not alter 8.25 beats. A larger shorten-and-extend gesture with quarter-note snap finally reached 30.000s.
findings.recommendation: Show live start/end/duration in bars and seconds while trimming, offer mouse step buttons or drag-value controls, and provide a direct 30-second export/range field.

findings.finding: Loop and timeline units need clearer relationship
findings.observed: Stock Loop remained active with Beats 1.00-17.00 after the arrangement grew to 30s. The ruler shows bar numbers and seconds; the range reads beats. I disabled Loop to play the whole arrangement.
findings.recommendation: Use a visible loop region with bar-and-second labels and a discoverable loop-entire-arrangement action.

findings.observed: Mixer gain readouts showed -6.0206 dB and -2.498775 dB. These make simple balancing look more technical than needed.
findings.recommendation: Round normal gain display to one decimal place while retaining precise internal values.

findings.finding: Master meter was silent while track meters moved
findings.observed: Both track meters were lit, while Master displayed negative infinity. Final WAV was nonzero. Null audio output may explain this; not classified as a verified app defect.
findings.recommendation: Confirm master-meter behavior on real output before changing audio routing or UI.

positive_findings: Drop audio here / Double-click for MIDI made track creation discoverable.
Device library clearly identified the available instrument as VST3 and offered Assign instrument.
Pencil help explains dragging to set length, and drawing beyond initial clip end extends the clip.
Context Duplicate plus marquee selection and Fit made repetition easy.
Export dialog showed exact duration; progress and finished status provided confidence.
Default filenames allowed project/WAV/MIDI saving without keyboard input.
limitations: Simulated participant, not a human first-time user.
Only test-fixture VST available; no third-party instrument compatibility or sound browsing assessed.
Null output prevented listening, so ambient aesthetic and sound quality were not validated.
Stock audio starter was used instead of importing a separate recording.
